xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex72012025-02-2416-45-50" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5181"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3706">shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rgyan gyi bstan <lb n="157a2"/> bcos</rs> 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i rgya cher bshad pa mdo'i don gsal bar byed pa</rs> zhes bya ba 'di ni yang dag pa'i don la 'jug par byed pa'i tha snyad tshad ma'i tshul rig cing sde snod gsum la blo'i snang ba rgyas shing yum gyi dgongs pa mdo 'grel dang bcas pa kha yun du sbyangs pas nges pa'i don la blo gzhol ba <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4005">bsam bstan bzang po</rs>s ¦ <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5181">mdo <lb n="157a3"/> rgyan 'grel</rs> ¦ 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i don tshig nyung bar bsdus shing thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7860">bla ma bka' lung shes rab sing ge</rs> <note type="editorial">Identification of dka' bzhi pa shes rab seng ge (ID: 7860) is tentative</note> dang ¦ khams gsum ma 'gran bzla thams cad dang bral ba shes bya kun la lta ba'i mig cig por gyur pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4593">bla ma mkhas pa chen po nus ston</rs> gyi gsung gi man ngag gis brgyan te | dga' ba'i lo <lb n="157a4"/> lo sgron gyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs tshes brgyad la <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4411">dpal ldan snar thang gi gtsug lag khang</rs> du rdzogs par sbyar ba'o || ||</seg></TEI>
